title: Tongariro Crossing Hike
summary: Landscape work from the Tongariro Alpine Crossing — dawn on the trail, the volcanic cone under a lenticular cloud, steaming vents, and the Emerald Lakes seen from the ridge.
blurb: Example blurb — this text sits in the panel to the left of the first gallery image and scrolls/scales along with the photos. Replace it in series.json with a few sentences about this shoot.

images.alt: An Emerald Lake mirroring a rocky volcanic slope under a clear blue sky
Hikers descending the trail at dawn with a wide valley and pink sky beyond
Two hikers on a ridge silhouetted against billowing volcanic steam
The volcanic cone of Ngauruhoe capped by a lenticular cloud at first light
The Emerald Lakes and steaming vents seen from the ridge, hikers on the path below
Layered volcanic ridgelines receding into the distance under a pale sky
